[To [Margaret Gatty](../persons.html#549)]Pray tell [Juliana](../persons.html#494) that I have been told of a master at Rugby who was so fascinated with The Brownies that he ordered all the 30 old volumes of the [magazine](../others.html#52) for his house!

[^1]: ‘The Brownies’ had appeared in the MP (December 1865).

Maxwell writes: \'Early in 1866 there was a letter from Miss Yonge to say that it [the Brownies] had evoked a perfect chorus of approval and in her opinion it had been the most successful that they had had in the Monthly Packet for a long time.\' This letter was sent “shortly afterwards”.
